text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the summer camp, an important training opportunity that can make or break a racer's future performance on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to achieve victory in the Japan Cup, Tokai Teio prepares to train like her life depends on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My annual summer camp with Tokai Teio begins again!
